item.title: "What saved Anthony Joshua in fatal road accident": Pastor Adeboye reveals
item.description: RCCG general overseer, Pastor Enoch Adeboye, has revealed what saved British-Nigerian boxer Anthony Joshua in accident as two friends tragically lost their lives.

item.title: Tax laws: How to know if you are taxable in Nigeria according to new residency rules
item.description: Nigeria’s new tax law defined residency rules, clarified who was taxable, and explained worldwide versus Nigeria-sourced income obligations as of today.

item.title: AFCON 2025: Super Eagles star Frank Onyeka reveals game plan to beat Mozambique in Round of 16 clash
item.description: Super Eagles midfielder Frank Onyeka discusses coach Eric Chelle's strategy before Nigeria faces Mozambique in the AFCON 2025 Round of 16 clash on January 5.

item.title: Revealed: How much FG approved for Super Eagles at AFCON 2025
item.description: Federal Government approves ₦3 billion bonus for Super Eagles ahead of their Round of 16 clash with Mozambique at AFCON 2025 in Morocco, ensuring team focus.

item.title: "A night of horror": Armed bandits kill 30, set market ablaze in popular northern state
item.description: Armed bandits attack Kasuwan Daji market in Niger State, killing over 30 and kidnapping many. Witnesses claim more than 50 victims were tied and slain.

item.title: "Relentless pursuit: Airstrike eliminates 23 terrorists fleeing attacks in popular northern state
item.description: Troops from the Joint Task Force have killed 23 bandits in Kano State after coordinated airstrikes, as tensions escalate in Shanono and Tsanyawa LGAs.

item.title: Watch video: "Marked for death": Gumi claims US plans to eliminate him with an airstrike
item.description: Sheikh Ahmad Gumi has alleged that the United States is plotting his assassination via airstrike, urging Northern leaders to confront these claims in a viral video

item.title: Pastor Chris Okafor summoned by Lagos police over serious allegations: Victims assured confidentiality
item.description: Lagos State Police summon Pastor Chris Okafor amid sexual misconduct allegations, assuring victim confidentiality as investigations commence on 5 January 2026.

item.title: Jamiu Azeez defends his right to religion amid conversion rumours: 'It's my life'
item.description: Yoruba actor Jamiu Azeez responded to claims of converting to Christianity from Islam after a viral church video, defending his right to practise any religion.
